Женьшень.about: Ginseng: improves memory (MA 2024 SMD 0.19, high doses 0.33), attention and cognition do not change; American ginseng—fatigue in cancer therapy (ASCO 2024).
Женьшень.caution: Safety data in healthy subjects is limited; in case of cancer - coordinate with the oncologist; in healthy people the effect is small.
Женьшень.course: According to RCT schemes (usually weeks-months), incl. during cancer therapy for fatigue.
Женьшень.food_sources: Ginseng is a root, not a food product; used in the form of extracts, powders and teas; tradition - East Asia (Panax ginseng).
Женьшень.guidelines: MA 2024 (15 RCT, n=671): memory SMD 0.19, high dose 0.33; ASCO-SIO 2024: American ginseng - for fatigue, low-moderate confidence; adaptogens: chronic fatigue.
Женьшень.how_to_choose: Panax ginseng (Asian) - for memory; American ginseng (Panax quinquefolius) - for fatigue in cancer therapy; standardized extracts, doses according to research schemes.
mechs: Taking ginseng preparations for memory impairment
resistance to stress without increasing oxygen consumption, historical use
Женьшень.myths: “Ginseng improves all thinking” - MA: memory yes, attention and executive functions no. “Any ginseng is the same” - fatigue has been studied in American. “Adaptogens are good for everyone”—the data for healthy people is weak.
Женьшень.name: Ginseng
Женьшень.onset: Course: effect on memory in MA 2024 when taking ginseng preparations in RCT; for fatigue - for the duration of therapy according to the ASCO scheme.
Женьшень.title: Ginseng
Женьшень.who_needs: For memory impairment, the effect is significant, higher at high doses (SMD 0.33); during cancer therapy - American ginseng for fatigue (ASCO recommendation); in healthy people the effect is small.
